description: Final results for one outright tournament: each golfer's position (shared when tied, null when cut, withdrawn or disqualified), madeCut and status, plus winners per market (Winner, Top N, Top N (Incl. Ties), Make Cut). Empty until the tournament is settled. Dead-heat and each-way terms are the bookmaker's rules. Needs the Outrights add-on (403 without it: tell the user, do not retry).
name: get_outright_results
title: Outright results
